up: Retrieve the exact activity values for all compounds tested in the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1613992. For each activity, include the compound's ChEMBL ID, its preferred name (if available), the standard activity type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Only include rows where the relation equals '=' (exact measurement) and the standard value is not null. Do not limit the number of rows. Output all relevant activity records.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS compound_pref_name,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM assays ass
JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613992'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
